technique_name: Write a 300-400 word essay about the role of technology in the healthcare industry.
description: Technology has revolutionized healthcare in recent years, allowing for drastically improved care of patients. Digital health tools and artificial intelligence (AI) have become increasingly common in healthcare settings, providing new ways to diagnose and treat illness and running increasingly complex medical systems.
